result.instructions: Tools for Usermaven, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the workspaces this Usermaven API key can access."; "Find the order_completed event for order ORD-123 in March 2026."; "Correct the final_price on that order event to 149.99.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Usermaven data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run usermaven_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run usermaven_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run usermaven_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. usermaven_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: usermaven_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the Usermaven workspaces that the API key can access. Calls GET /v1/workspaces with the X-API-KEY header. The public docs do not describe the response shape, so the raw JSON is returned.

tools.name: usermaven_lookup_events
tools.title: Look up events
tools.description: Find events by event type, time range and an optional custom attribute, such as an order id. Returns at most 10 events, newest first. Leave attribute_key and attribute_value both empty to skip the attribute filter. Needs the API key and the Server Token. Calls POST /v1/event-mutation/lookup. Changes can take up to 1 minute to appear.

event_type.description: Event type to search, for example order_completed.

attribute_key.description: Attribute name to match, for example order_id. Empty with attribute_value skips the filter.

attribute_value.description: Attribute value to match, for example ORD-123. Empty with attribute_key skips the filter.

tools.name: usermaven_update_event_attributes
tools.title: Update event attributes
tools.description: Change the custom attributes of one event that Usermaven already ingested, for example to correct a final order price. merge (default) adds or updates the given keys; replace removes every other attribute. Reuse the same idempotency_key to retry safely. Needs the API key and the Server Token. Calls POST /v1/event-mutation. System events cannot be changed.

event_id.description: The event_id to change (a UUID), from usermaven_lookup_events.

timestamp.description: A time near the original event time, in the same calendar month as the event.

event_attributes.description: Attributes to write on the event. Up to 10 KB.

merge_mode.description: merge (default) keeps the other attributes; replace removes them.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for this change. A retry with the same key returns the first result and is not applied twice.
